Onde quem instalou o sistema vê a versão: Where whoever installed the system sees the version in use, finds out a new version is out, reads what changes and requests the update without opening the server.
Reconhecer o aviso de versão nova, ler o: Recognize the new-version notice, read what changes and request the update from the screen.
The version in use sits at the bottom of the menu. When a new version is out, the "New version" notice appears right below it, with its number. Only whoever administers the installation sees this notice, because only that person can update. Click it.
A versão instalada e a nova: The installed version and the new one
A tela abre com o número da versão nova: The screen opens with the new version number in the title. The box right below shows the "Installed version", the latest official release and the date the server confirmed what is running. The "Revision" is the exact code of the version, useful if you ask for help.
Mais abaixo, \"O que muda\" lista as nov: Further down, "What changes" lists the new version's changes as the project itself published them. If any of them needs action from you, a yellow "Requires attention" box appears before the button, and it is worth reading before updating.
Ao lado de \"Atualizar agora\", a tela a: Next to "Update now", the screen says what happens: the system goes offline for about 2 minutes and comes back on its own, and a backup of the data is made first. Pick a quiet time and click.
O pedido fica anotado e o servidor confe: The request is recorded and the server checks every few minutes whether there is something to do: the update may take about five minutes to start, and a still screen during that time is normal. The clock shows how long the request has been waiting. You can close the page: the request is not lost, and the screen follows each step on its own until the system is back.
Plantão conforme a jornada: On call according to the schedule
